MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy feels like a natural next choice because I have used tape and vinyl cement for repairs, and it gives me a way to make stronger rigid repairs.",
    "The caliper and thread checker would help me measure hoses, fittings, and hardware before choosing matching parts, which connects directly to my use of clamps and repair supplies."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The infrared thermometers are useful tools, but I have no temperature-checking task in mind; owning repair supplies does not make them useful to me right now.",
    "Another wireless endoscope duplicates something I already own, while twelve wastebaskets do not address any need suggested by my recent purchases.",
    "The connector kit and super glue fit my interests, but their large quantities overlap supplies I already have; I would choose the epoxy now and wait on those."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to assume that any workshop or repair tool will interest me, even when it serves a task I have not needed to do.",
    "My previous purchases of assortments and bulk supplies seem to be taken as a reason to offer more large packs, regardless of whether I need that quantity."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "An item that adds a useful repair capability appeals more than another version of equipment I already own.",
    "Interest in a supply does not mean I need it now: I would wait for a specific sealing job before buying butyl tape and a need for more connectors before buying another assortment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but miss the difference between a useful next capability, a duplicate purchase, and supplies for a job I do not currently have."
}
